scope: All 15 tenancy/repair/bond entries remaining after the critical and health-safety reviews in the immutable restricted/network-error baseline. Reference line numbers are historical. Not a full legal review.

reviews.title: Condition reports for rental properties
reviews.note: The tenant returns one amended, signed copy within two days after receiving the reports. Added that trigger to the first-week guide; key handover and actual moving day must not be substituted. Missing damage/cleanliness details and dated photos remain relevant.

reviews.title: Request repairs to a rental property
reviews.note: The overview includes response periods, written follow-up and evidence for an Order for repairs. It explicitly permits applying before the periods expire, although the Commissioner may delay an order. Detailed urgent/emergency pages qualify the overview's 24-hour wording; removed the blanket wait-until-expiry implication.

reviews.title: Renting in the NT
reviews.note: The agency index supplies residential tenancy advice, forms and NTCAT application guidance. Its RT04a/RT04b labels differ from the individual government tenant-notices page. Added a visible confirmation route, not a legal determination of which downloaded form to send.

reviews.title: Common tenancy disputes
reviews.note: Read the security deposit sections: seven business days concerns the landlord's return/retention notice; reasons, receipts/invoices, statutory declaration and unclaimed balance are distinguished from a tenant's NTCAT filing period. The page also has historical COVID material, not used for current advice.

reviews.title: Notices for tenants to landlords
reviews.note: The public page lists RT06 tenant termination and RT12 unclaimed bond, distinct from NTCAT applications. Its RT04b label differs from the Consumer Affairs index. Retained the useful public list with a warning to confirm form title and sender/recipient; no PDF was completed or submitted.

reviews.title: Repairs and maintenance on rented properties
reviews.note: The page distinguishes verbal reporting from written notice needed to enforce a request and describes emergency and other repairs. Kept the existing escalation summary; did not turn five-day/14-day procedural wording into advice to remain in immediate danger or to stop paying rent.

reviews.title: Parties' rights disputes
reviews.note: SACAT accepts applications to remedy breaches or clarify rights while a tenancy continues, including failure to repair. Public application assistance and scope are present. The guide retains this escalation entry without opening or submitting an application.

reviews.title: Renting
reviews.note: The official TAS hub links beginning a tenancy, condition reports, bond claims/disputes, maintenance and ending a tenancy. Retained the existing entry in both moving and rental selectors. This is hub/destination verification, not a review of every linked page.

reviews.title: Claiming a rental bond
reviews.note: The tenant response is within ten days of the owner's claim being lodged. The page mixes three days and three working days for the initial owner/tenant claim timing; no unconditional numeric tenant-start rule was added. Confirm MyBond/RDA conditions and actual notices before acting.

reviews.title: Disputing a bond claim
reviews.note: Both parties provide evidence within ten working days after dispute notification, distinct from the initial ten-day claim response. Commissioner determinations, separate court appeals and excluded compensation/agent conduct are described. No appeal deadline or decision-time guarantee was invented.

reviews.title: Renting forms
reviews.note: The official forms index includes Application for order for repairs, described as a printable hard-copy PDF, not an online-completable form. Confirmed list purpose and retained it with a submission-method reminder. Did not inspect, fill or submit individual forms.

reviews.title: Bonds FAQs
reviews.note: The FAQ permits tenant refund requests after exit, distinguishes multi-tenant agreement, notice response and counter-offers, and links the current dispute guide. Processing estimates were not rewritten as guaranteed payouts or response deadlines. The public list remains useful.

reviews.title: Repairs and maintenance
reviews.note: The SA page distinguishes immediate reporting of urgent repairs from other written requests, including Request for repairs, licensed trades and a written repair report. It links SACAT remedies. Existing source and procedural warnings retained; no unqualified reimbursement or automatic termination promise.

reviews.title: Moving out of your rental property
reviews.note: The official checklist covers proper written notice, inspection-sheet comparison, photos, utilities, keys and forwarding contacts. Its bond link reaches current refund/dispute information. Removed the unsupported implication that final inspection is a universal legal prerequisite to starting an SA refund request.

reviews.title: Renting and letting
reviews.note: The original short SA URL remains an accessible official rental hub with private renting, public/community housing, rooming houses, bond refunds and dispute links. A bot restriction in the original audit did not justify replacing this working entry.

supportingSources.title: General repairs to rental properties
supportingSources.note: General repairs not caused by tenants: 28 days after notification, with a 14-day cooking-stove exception. Urgent classification remains separate.

supportingSources.title: Urgent repairs to rental properties
supportingSources.note: Essential-service failure, as-soon-as-possible repair and inability to contact the owner within 24 hours before the nominated-repairer route.

supportingSources.title: Emergency repairs to rental properties
supportingSources.note: Damage that worsens without prompt repair; owner cannot be contacted and nominated/suitably-qualified repairer conditions. Does not impose the urgent page's 24-hour wait.

supportingSources.title: Settling a bond dispute
supportingSources.note: Managing-party and tenant non-consented claims, counter-offer and SACAT routes differ. The 14-day managing-party non-response rule is not recast as every tenant's response period.

supportingSources.title: Bond refunds
supportingSources.note: Supporting navigation check from Moving out: consented refunds, alternative forms and separate dispute/unclaimed routes. Not added as a duplicate article source.

supportingSources.title: RBO user portal
supportingSources.note: Public landing page reached from the refund page's Request a refund link via /RBOportal redirect. Individual/business logins are distinct; stopped before login or submission.
